sources.text:
Orchard planting card, 18 April 2027

The pear beside the cistern and the pear beside the tool shed were planted during the same planting day. The order book calls each tree 'new pear'. For the survey, the cistern tree has tag C and the shed tree has tag S. Both trees were tied to their stakes with white cloth.

Orchard survey, 19 April 2027

C, beside the cistern: open blossoms on the branches; white cloth tie intact.

S, beside the tool shed: no flowers on the branches; white cloth tie intact.

This survey records the trees on 19 April. It contains no later visits.
